HeroName: Briain Ua Briain, Prince of Tuadhmhumhain
Description: Briain Ua Briain, known to history as Brian Roe, is the fierce prince and designated tanist of Thomond, commanding the kingdom's elite frontline battle-axemen. Embodying the fiery martial spirit of his father King Conor, he is a warrior of immense physical strength, personal audacity, and turbulent ambition. Brian routinely leads sudden counter-attacks against Anglo-Norman patrols pushing westward from Limerick, wielding a heavy two-handed battleaxe with devastating lethality that has made his name dreaded across the Pale. He categorically refuses any accommodation with foreign settlers, advocating preemptive scorched-earth raids to obliterate Norman estates across Munster. Fiercely proud of his Dalcassian royal bloodline, he views the high-kingship claims of northern dynasties with unvarnished skepticism, determined to establish Thomond as an unassailable sovereign kingdom. Adored by veteran fighters for his reckless courage, young Brian is a rising tempest on the Irish frontier.
Motivations: Expel Anglo-Norman warlords from Limerick and expand Thomond's dominion across Munster.
Succeed to the throne and forge an unassailable Dalcassian military superpower.
Values: Fierce warrior honor and raw military dominance.
Uncompromising native pride that bows to neither foreign king nor domestic rival.
Fears: Rival kinsmen inviting English arbitration to usurp his rightful inheritance.
Dying in bed without matching the immortal conquests of Brian Boru.
SpeechStyle: Speaks with ferocious, booming arrogance and razor-sharp military conviction, confrontational and impatient with anything short of complete battlefield triumph.
